args.title: Retail Returns — Summary (brightline.example, 2026)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, driven by sizing/fit issues and easy online return policies.
- Consolidated return-handling hubs reduced processing/handling costs by about 20% versus decentralized returns processing.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned apparel within 10 days of the original sale preserved most of the item's margin, making speed-to-resale a key lever for profitability.
